notes.title: Patch notes - 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello!
This is a small patch that fix [b]Ruinen[/b] (4th mission in Axis Campaign):

[list]
[*]Reduced the damage of the enemies in the city.
[*]More health kits added.
[/list]

Hope this get the mission a little easier. Thank you!

[i]Terfilis[/i]

notes.title: Free Campaign now avalible! - Fall Gelb
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323386/4507001d4845a369476c7c25c21ace8a3961b505.jpg[/img]

Fall Gelb is now avalible for everyone! Includes a new campaign with two new missions based in the invasion of France in May, 1940.

[list]
[*]Ardennen: In the axis side, you need to regroup with your allies to take a farm but first you need to go throught dangerous zones...
[*]Resister: In the allies side, defend a crossroad with your allies during a fierce German attack. When the battle breaks, you can ask for radio for reinforcements, ammunition, or first aid kits.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323386/5347ca17aa314f1bed75760c25a2918828abeed2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42323386/a90c2b1f86b438632072d0896ae8fb6799ae5354.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes - 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello! This is the list of improvements in this new update:

[list]
[*] The order of the missions has been changed to make the campaigns easier at the beginning.
[*] Added feedback when you hit an enemy.
[*] Added settings menu while playing a mission.
[*] Balanced difficulty.
[/list]

[i]Terfilis[/i]
